name: Kaminaru Kimi to
source:
At a small shrine in a small, quiet countryside village, the heroine hears a voice calling her...
"The time has come to fulfill our promise, our thousand year promise."
She faints and when she wakes up, she finds she is now becoming a god...
A love story starts to unfold, along with warmth, kindness and sadness.
